issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Wizstar
products.tagline: Digital avatars that move and act like professional actors
products.summaryZh: 数字化身，其动作与表现如同专业演员。
products.descriptionZh: Wizstar帮助创始人、创作者和制作者构建一个富有表现力且精准的数字形象大使，外观和动作都与您一致。它能自然做手势、与物体互动，并保持精准的唇形同步——即使在转头或有物体遮挡面部时也不例外。无需每次出镜，即可制作产品更新、培训、本地化视频和品牌内容。让您的数字形象活起来，并跨市场、语言和渠道扩展。
products.description: Wizstar helps founders, creators, and makers build an expressive, accurate digital ambassador that looks and moves like you. It gestures naturally, interacts with objects, and maintains precise lip sync—even during head turns or things in front of your face. Create product updates, training, localized videos, and branded content without being on camera every time. Bring your digital presence to life and scale it across markets, languages, and channels.

products.name: Supernova
products.tagline: All your data in Claude and Codex
products.summaryZh: 你在Claude和Codex中的所有数据
products.descriptionZh: Supernova将你初创公司的实时数据连接到Claude和Codex，让任何人都能在他们已使用的AI工具中提问、调查表现并运行复杂分析。连接Stripe、HubSpot、PostgreSQL及其他30多个应用，无需等待工程师或将所有数据迁移至传统BI栈，即可分析收入、销售管道、客户、使用情况和运营。
products.description: Supernova connects your startup’s live data to Claude and Codex, so anyone can ask questions, investigate performance, and run complex analysis in the AI tools they already use. Connect Stripe, HubSpot, PostgreSQL, and 30+ other apps, then analyze revenue, pipeline, customers, usage, and operations without waiting on engineers or moving everything into a traditional BI stack.

products.name: Mindcase
products.tagline: Extract data from anywhere on the web within minutes
products.summaryZh: 从网页任意位置提取数据，只需几分钟。
products.descriptionZh: Mindcase是用于以结构化、可用格式提取网页数据的基础设施层。专为需要可靠网页数据而无需管理抓取基础设施的开发者与AI团队打造。通过API访问热门数据源，或针对您的特定用例，将网络上的任意内容构建为定制API。
products.description: Mindcase is the infrastructure layer for extracting web data in a structured, usable format. Built for developers and AI teams that need reliable web data without managing scraping infrastructure. Access APIs across popular sources, or get anything across the web built as a custom API for your specific use case.

products.name: fx (by Vercel)
products.tagline: Vercel's tiny, open-source coding agent
products.summaryZh: Vercel 的微型开源编码代理
products.descriptionZh: fx 是 Vercel 推出的微型开源编码代理，旨在不干扰你的工作流程。它采用 Zig 编写，以约 6MB 的原生二进制形式发布，几乎瞬间启动，同时保持较低的内存和上下文开销。可搭配本地或云端模型使用，通过技能、插件和 MCP 进行扩展，或嵌入到你自己的代理基础设施中。设计上追求小巧，从而为模型留出更多工作空间。
products.description: fx is Vercel's tiny, open-source coding agent built to get out of your way. Written in Zig and shipped as a ~6MB native binary, it starts almost instantly while keeping memory and context overhead low. Use it with local or cloud models, extend it with skills, plugins and MCPs, or embed it into your own agent infrastructure. Small by design, so the model gets more room to work.

products.name: Antigravity IDE Extensions
products.tagline: Antigravity agents now live inside your existing editor
products.summaryZh: 抗重力剂现已集成至您现有的编辑器中。
products.descriptionZh: Antigravity IDE 扩展将 Google 的智能体编码平台引入 VS Code、Visual Studio、JetBrains 和 Zed。在查看内联差异、检查计划、调试代码以及交接多步骤任务时，无需离开编辑器即可保留智能体对话和共享上下文。
products.description: Antigravity IDE Extensions bring Google’s agentic coding platform into VS Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains, and Zed. Keep your agent conversations and shared context while reviewing inline diffs, inspecting plans, debugging code, and handing off multi-step tasks without leaving your editor.

products.name: Epho
products.tagline: Run Claude Code, Codex or Opencode in cloud with your repo
products.summaryZh: 在云端运行Claude Code、Codex或Opencode，并关联你的代码仓库。
products.descriptionZh: Epho在云端运行claude code、codex或opencode。发送一条消息，即可流式接收工作结果。无需SDK、无需守护进程、无需自建基础设施。Epho为您管理底层沙箱、回退机制、事件流和代理配置。通过一次API调用，即可轻松启动一个已连接至您的代码仓库、理解您的上下文并在无服务器沙箱中运行的Claude Code会话。
products.description: Epho runs claude code, codex, or opencode in the cloud. POST a message, stream back the work. no sdk, no daemon, no infra on your side. Epho manages the underlying sandboxes, fallbacks, event streaming, and agent configuration for you. With a single API call, you can easily launch a Claude Code session that is already connected to your repo, understands your context, and runs in a serverless sandbox.

products.name: OneCLI
products.tagline: Give every employee a secured, sandboxed pro assistant agent
products.summaryZh: 为每位员工配备一个安全、沙盒化的专业助手代理。
products.descriptionZh: 完成工作的最佳方式，而非空谈或亲力亲为。开源、安全的智能代理，可在Slack及网页端使用。面向团队的自托管代理框架：沙箱隔离、策略控制，绝不触及真实凭证。
products.description: The best way to get work done, instead of chatting about it and doing it yourself. Open-source, secure agents, in Slack and on the web. Self-hosted agent harness for teams: sandboxed, policy-controlled, and never touching a real credential.

products.name: Plow Latch
products.tagline: Run AI agents on your Mac with scoped access
products.summaryZh: 在Mac上运行AI代理，并赋予其受限访问权限。
products.descriptionZh: 安全地让您的代理真正控制您的Mac，同时保持数据本地存储。借助Plow Latch，您几乎可以用AI完成在Mac上能做的所有事情。
products.description: Safely give your agent real control of your Mac, while keeping your data local on your machine. With Plow Latch, pretty much anything you can do with your Mac, you can do with your AI.

products.name: Dockhand
products.tagline: Docker management for everyone
products.summaryZh: 面向所有人的Docker管理
products.descriptionZh: 适用于单台主机或整个集群的Docker管理器。- 从单一界面管理本地、远程TLS及NAT/VPS主机- 部署和更新Compose堆栈，包括通过Git自动同步- 实时日志、指标及浏览器内容器终端- 在镜像发布前扫描每个镜像的CVE漏洞（Grype/Trivy）- 从1Password、Vault、Infisical、Doppler注入密钥- 加密备份至本地、S3或GCS- 带发布说明的Semver更新徽章- 支持SSO、LDAP及基于角色的访问控制加固且免费。
products.description: Docker manager for one host or a whole fleet. - Manage local, remote TLS, and NAT'd/VPS hosts from one UI - Deploy & update Compose stacks, incl. from Git with auto-sync - Live logs, metrics, and an in-browser container shell - Scan every image for CVEs (Grype/Trivy) before it ships - Inject secrets from 1Password, Vault, Infisical, Doppler - Encrypted backups to local, S3, or GCS - Semver update badges with release notes - SSO, LDAP, and role-based access Hardened and free.

products.name: Surfdeck
products.tagline: Your tabs, within reach.
products.summaryZh: 你的标签页，触手可及。
products.descriptionZh: 将您最常访问的网站置于手边，直接从Mac菜单栏快速访问。
products.description: Keep your favorite sites close at hand, right from your Mac's menu bar.

products.name: Router by Ramp
products.tagline: Tokens are money. Save both.
products.summaryZh: Token 即金钱。两者皆省。
products.descriptionZh: 别再为LLM推理多花钱，也别再为多个API集成忙得团团转。Router.com提供一个统一的API端点，将每个请求路由到满足性能门槛的最低成本模型，并依托Ramp的财务透明度作为支撑。立即访问router.com，开始更智能的路由吧！
products.description: Stop overpaying for LLM inference and juggling multiple API integrations. Router.com provides a single API endpoint that routes every request to the lowest-cost model that meets your performance threshold—backed by Ramp's financial visibility. Start routing smarter today at router.com!

products.name: Local
products.tagline: Zero (!) friction local AI for your Mac
products.summaryZh: Mac 上零（！）摩擦的本地 AI
products.descriptionZh: Local是一款macOS应用，直接在您的设备上运行完全私密的AI。我们为它打造了零摩擦的安装体验。它能根据您的硬件自动调优，使聊天、编程代理和会议记录在同一硬件上运行速度提升至5.4倍，且数据永不离开设备。无云端，无账户，无成本。“办公模式”让您能在办公室最快的机器上运行AI，每台笔记本电脑都能连接它。
products.description: Local is a macOS app that runs fully private AI directly on your own machine. We built it for completely frictionless setup. It tunes itself to your hardware, so chat, coding agents and meeting notes run up to 5.4x faster on the same hardware, without your data ever leaving the device. No cloud. No accounts. No cost. "Office Mode" let's you run AI on the fastest machine in the office and every laptop can connect to it.

products.name: Flunkey
products.tagline: Voice-first AI layer for Windows (beta)
products.summaryZh: Windows 的语音优先AI层（测试版）
products.descriptionZh: Flunkey是一款面向Windows的语音优先生产力工具，能将口述想法转化为文本、实用操作及工作场景中的记忆上下文。它与Wispr Flow类似，但内置AI功能，便于轻松提问。对学生、研究人员及依赖大量上下文的人群尤为高效，同时也可作为日常生活的通用工具。
products.description: Flunkey is a voice-first productivity tool for Windows that turns spoken thoughts into text, useful actions, and remembered context wherever you work. It is similar to Wispr Flow but has an AI feature which you can use to easily ask questions. It is really productive for students, researchers, and people who use a lot of context and is a general-purpose tool that you can use for your day-to-day lives.

products.name: Actx0
products.tagline: Memory infrastructure for AI agents.
products.summaryZh: 面向AI代理的记忆基础设施。
products.descriptionZh: 你的智能体在会话结束的瞬间就会忘记一切。你在每个提示中塞入更多上下文，在冗余历史上烧掉token，产出的回复却依然像失忆症多走了几步。Actx0 是你智能体缺失的记忆层——一个即插即用的基础设施，存储重要信息，毫秒级检索，并跨会话、智能体和应用持续工作。专为关注延迟、成本和可控性的生产团队打造。
products.description: Your agents forget everything the moment a session ends. You stuff more context into every prompt, burn tokens on redundant history, and still ship responses that feel like amnesia with extra steps. Actx0 is the memory layer your agents are missing — a drop-in infrastructure that stores what matters, retrieves it in milliseconds, and keeps working across sessions, agents, and apps. Built for production teams who care about latency, cost, and control.

products.name: ShogunAI
products.tagline: Your personal AGI on your PC. Built to finish real work.
products.summaryZh: 你的个人AGI，运行于你的PC之上。为完成实际工作而打造。
products.descriptionZh: 个人AGI不会以更好的聊天机器人形式出现，而是作为一个了解你工作全貌的智能体——你的每个人、每个项目、每个承诺——并据此行动。这就是ShogunAI：在你的工作中全面通用，而非局限于单一任务；它存在于你的个人电脑中，而非他人的云端。它在你工作时构建这一状态，保留每条记录背后的证据，并将其用于完成实际工作。阅读是自动的。发送始终等待你的批准，现支持macOS。
products.description: Personal AGI won't arrive as a better chatbot, rather it arrives as an agent that knows the full state of your work -very person, your every project, every promise - and acts on it That is ShogunAI: general across your work rather than narrow to one task, and living inside your PC rather than someone else's cloud it builds that state as you work, keeps the evidence behind every record, and spends it finishing real work. Reading is automatic. Sending always waits for your approval, macOS today.

products.name: Project SKY
products.tagline: Your ambient AI companion for Windows.
products.summaryZh: 你的Windows环境AI伴侣。
products.descriptionZh: Project SKY是一款原生为Windows设计的智能桌面伴侣。与局限于浏览器的聊天机器人不同，SKY直接运行于操作系统之上，具备空间屏幕感知、流畅对话语音和长期环境记忆能力。无论是需要即时屏幕分析配合圈选式智能选择、自动化桌面工作流，还是语音驱动的任务管理，SKY都能理解你在所有应用中的工作内容，而不打断你的专注。
products.description: Project SKY is an intelligent desktop companion designed natively for Windows. Unlike browser-bound chatbots, SKY lives directly on your operating system with spatial screen perception, fluid conversational voice, and long-term ambient memory. Whether you need instant screen analysis with circle-style smart selection, automated desktop workflows, or voice-driven task management, SKY understands what you're working on across all your applications without breaking your focus.

products.name: Outlook Google Calendar Sync for Mac
products.tagline: Sync Outlook calendars to Google on your Mac
products.summaryZh: 在Mac上将Outlook日历同步到Google
products.descriptionZh: Outlook Google Calendar Sync for Mac 可将您的 Outlook 事件镜像到 Google 日历中，无需 Microsoft 管理员审批。它在您的 Mac 上本地运行，支持多个日历同步任务，避免发送重复邀请，并在后台静默保持您的日程更新。
products.description: Outlook Google Calendar Sync for Mac keeps your Outlook events mirrored into Google Calendar without needing Microsoft admin approval. It runs locally on your Mac, supports multiple calendar sync jobs, avoids sending duplicate invites, and quietly keeps your schedule up to date in the background.

products.name: PixelRead AI OCR
products.tagline: Capture, translate, and understand any text on your Mac
products.summaryZh: 在Mac上捕捉、翻译并理解任何文本
products.descriptionZh: PixelRead 可将 Mac 屏幕上的任意文本转化为可用的内容。直接选择文本，或按 ⌘⇧2 在图片、视频、PDF、网站或应用上框选区域。随后可复制、在设备端翻译、用系统语音朗读，或使用 Apple Intelligence 进行摘要、改写、提取关键信息及提问。OCR、翻译和 AI 处理均在 Mac 上完成。macOS 15.2 及以上版本免费；翻译和 AI 功能需 macOS 26。
products.description: PixelRead turns any text on your Mac screen into something you can use. Select text directly or press ⌘⇧2 and draw a region over an image, video, PDF, website, or app. Then copy it, translate it on-device, listen with system voices, or use Apple Intelligence to summarize, rewrite, extract key details, and ask questions. OCR, translation, and AI processing stay on your Mac. Free for macOS 15.2+; Translate and AI features require macOS 26.

products.name: Lynqo
products.tagline: Your machine is a P2P server, review suite & clipboard sync.
products.summaryZh: 你的机器是一台P2P服务器、审查套件与剪贴板同步工具。
products.descriptionZh: Lynqo将你的Mac或PC变成极速本地服务器。共享视频文件、同步剪贴板，并获得帧级精确的客户反馈。零云端，零费用。
products.description: Lynqo turns your Mac or PC into a blazing-fast local server. Share video files, sync clipboards, and get frame-accurate client feedback. Zero cloud. Zero fees.

products.name: Jottify
products.tagline: Capture everything. Organize nothing.
products.summaryZh: 捕捉一切，无需整理。
products.descriptionZh: 用语音或文字随时记录想法。Jottify 能理解含义，跨越时间串联思路，并在日后需要时将其呈现。无需维护任何系统。
products.description: Dump any thought by voice or text. Jottify reads the meaning, connects ideas across time, and surfaces them when it's useful later. No system to maintain.
